boot_requirements.detail: When PMUIO1 falls below 2.93 V, assert RESETn before the other supplies power off. Model and bench tests need the actual detection and shutdown waveforms; an assumed reset state is not a verified supervisor.

boot_requirements.title: DDR3L power and initialization
boot_requirements.detail: ISSI requires stable power with RESET# asserted for at least 200 µs, followed by at least 500 µs from RESET# release to active CKE, plus the full initialization/ZQ sequence. DDR3_RESETn is distinct from SoC RESETn. These steps require actual memory-controller firmware and signal validation.

boot_requirements.title: eMMC rails stable before commands
boot_requirements.detail: VCC and VCCQ must both be stable before CMD; no relative power-on order is required by the guide. The replaceable module exact SKU, populated boot image and board-specific loader configuration remain unverified.

boot_requirements.title: Boot ROM → DDR loader → bootloader → OS
boot_requirements.detail: The dashboard represents prerequisites and assumed stage markers. It does not execute RK3566 instructions, Boot ROM, DDR training, TF-A, U-Boot or Linux. There is no serial boot log or memory test result.

limitations: The electrical audit does not modify the schematic, PCB or BOM, and its findings do not disappear when behavioral parameters are tuned.
No RK3566 instruction, Boot ROM, DDR initialization, TF-A, U-Boot or Linux emulation is provided; boot stages are prerequisite/state models.
No whole-board SPICE/IBIS model exists in the supplied design. IC internal currents, every signal waveform, RF and semiconductor switching cannot be inferred exactly from a netlist.
EMI results are geometry and switching-frequency risk indicators. No radiated/conducted dBµV or immunity pass result is claimed.
Behavioral rail loads, ESR/ESL, efficiency and regulator response must remain labeled assumptions until backed by device models or measurements.
RK3566 CPU/GPU/NPU recommended maximum voltages are not supplied by the retained table. The 1.2 V absolute maximum is a damage boundary, not an approved DVS operating point.
The generic RK809-1 sequence table must not be applied to RK809-5; exact variant/OTP and switch-current limits remain unresolved.
An 8/10 or higher simulation-workbench score concerns traceability, model checks and presentation, not boot probability, board readiness or EMC certification.

spice.scope: Independent switched-network SPICE calculation using L219 and local C382–C385 values. Fixed 5 V / 2 A experiment; it does not change with the main behavioral sliders.
limitations: Ideal PWM replaces U7; no vendor controller, protection, startup or stability model.
Bank ESR 3 mΩ, 2 ns switching edges, 2 A load and lumped interconnect are assumptions.
480 kHz is a sensitivity point, not a guaranteed TPS566242 lower frequency.
EM emissions, return currents, radiated field strength and EMC compliance are not calculated.
